faq.a: Stainless steel cutlery sets and kitchen utensils for B2B orders, including wholesale, hospitality, retail and private-label projects. Availability and specifications are confirmed by model.

faq.q: Do you support OEM, ODM and private-label enquiries?
faq.a: Depending on the product, discuss logos, finish, set composition, handle treatment and branded packaging. New molds and structural changes require a separate feasibility review.

faq.q: Which stainless steel grades are available?
faq.a: Options in the current catalogue include 201, 304, 410 and 430 stainless steel. Availability differs by model and component; confirm the exact grade of each piece before ordering.

faq.q: What should I send for a quotation?
faq.a: Send the model or reference photo, quantity, destination, material, finish, logo and packaging requirements, and target delivery date. Request written confirmation of MOQ, samples and lead time.

faq.q: Can I request samples and test documents?
faq.a: Ask for sample availability, fees and timing for your model. Any material or food-contact document must match the relevant product, material batch and destination requirements.

ctaBand.title: Tell Us What You Need to Source
ctaBand.subtitle: Send the model or reference photo, quantity and destination. We will review the brief and reply with the available route.
